decision: Decide whether Jamie's practice of turning emerging, stakeholder-heavy work into usable operating structure merits a resume review and conversation.
targetRole: Technical Project Manager - Product Operations & Implementation
governingArgument: Jamie surfaces the structure already emerging in complex work, then gives it resilient form through requirements, workflows, decision records, implementation, public-facing tools, documentation, and handoff.
deferredDepth: Artistic and civic history that does not clarify the first-pass hiring decision
antiArgument: Do not present Jamie as a generic administrator.
Do not make every project carry the whole career story.
Do not turn collective outcomes into individual causality.
Do not make archive size a proxy for professional value.
primaryAction: Review the canonical resume and contact Jamie for a conversation.
compositionRule: Use the smallest set of source-backed proofs that establishes role fit, operating method, outcomes, and present-tense capability; retain additional mature evidence in the Knowledge Bank.
